messages.subject: [acs-r] Plans for updated data??
messages.body_plain:
I'm getting back to Census data and acs.R this month for a project with
Hack Oregon. I believe the latest ACS data went public today; are there any
plans to add the XML descriptions to acs.tables.install?
-- 
How many people can stand on the shoulders of a giant before the giant
collapses?
